title: Email is required
why: Confirms that a missing email is caught by validation before anything is saved.

steps.does: POST …/identity/register-user with Email empty (and a second attempt with Email omitted). All other fields are valid: FirstName Anna, LastName Meyer, UserName anna.meyer, PassPortNumber DE9876543, Password Str0ng!Pass1, matching ConfirmPassword.

expect: Both requests are rejected with a validation error naming Email as required. No User row is created.
